name: Rizuhble's Babysitter Dynamo
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,800 (levels 1-15). 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Sprint Boots.

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Kinetic Pulse (2 to 3).

items.name: Headshot Booster
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Heroic Aura, 16000 souls (~16.0 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Regen
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Sprint Boots completes 6,400 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (vitality): Sprint Boots completes 4.8k vitality in 6400 souls (~6.4 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Healing Rite
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Sprint Boots completes 5,600 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (vitality): Sprint Boots completes 4.8k vitality in 5600 souls (~5.6 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Rescue Beam
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Sprint Boots completes 3,200 souls on. Upgrade of Healing Rite (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (vitality): Sprint Boots completes 4.8k vitality in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Headhunter
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Heroic Aura, 9600 souls (~9.6 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,800-20,800 (levels 15-26). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Rejuvenating Aurora T3, Singularity T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Kinetic Pulse, damage) grows from 161 to 249. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Compress Cooldown, weapon 4.8k at Heroic Aura.

items.name: Trophy Collector
items.caption: Builds toward the 6.4k vitality tier, which Healing Booster completes 800 souls on. Upgrade of Sprint Boots (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Healing Booster completes 6.4k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Healing Booster
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 5,600 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Kinetic Pulse (3 to 4). Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Singularity: takes 18% off its 250s base cooldown.
items.legacy_note: On the ult.

items.name: Heroic Aura
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (3,200 to 6,400 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k tiers): bonus 18 to 54% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Only if your team has gun heroes.

items.name: Enchanter's Emblem
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 8,000 invested: bonus 42 to 46 vitality bonus. | Its +15 spirit and 5% cooldown reduction only count above 65% health, which fits a healer who is not being focused but is lost once you are dived.

items.name: Duration Extender
items.caption: Imbued on Singularity: its duration-scaled parts (channel time 3.5s) get +22%. Takes spirit from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: On the ult.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 20,800-41,600 (levels 26-34). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Quantum Entanglement T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Kinetic Pulse, damage) grows from 249 to 373.

items.name: Warp Stone
items.caption: Singularity is centred on you (no cast range, 7m pull), so the 11m teleport is how you land inside the group before channelling; the 30% bullet resist lasts 6s, longer than the whole channel. Takes vitality from 8,000 to 11,200 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Teleport into the middle of them, then ult.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 6,400 to 8,000 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power. | With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 318s; 20% off is 63.6s per full rotation.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Imbued on Kinetic Pulse: widens its range (stomp range, stomp width).
items.legacy_note: On Kinetic Pulse.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Singularity vacuum radius (9m), Kinetic Pulse stomp range (16m), Quantum Entanglement ally distance (13m). Takes spirit from 8,800 to 11,200 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Expansion (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Singularity channel time (3.5s), Rejuvenating Aurora movement speed bonus duration (8s), Rejuvenating Aurora channel time (6s). Upgrade of Duration Extender (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.caption: Rejuvenating Aurora's heal counts as applying healing, so everyone it heals gets 35% fire rate and +1.25m/s move speed for 7s (innate regen and lifesteal do not trigger it). Takes vitality from 11,200 to 16,000 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Everyone your Aurora heals gets the fire rate and move speed.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 46.5 to Kinetic Pulse's damage (1.55x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Enchanter's Emblem? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Warp Stone.
sections.desc: Dying after Enchanter's Emblem? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Warp Stone.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun and Metal Skin isn't enough.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Knockdown before it lands, Slowing Hex, Disarming Hex.

items.name: Debuff Reducer
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Silences and slows keep you out of fights.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Quantum Entanglement (movement) and Rejuvenating Aurora (channelled). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Stuns that cancel your ult.

items.name: Spirit Rend
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Instead of Heroic Aura when your team has no gun heroes.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)
items.legacy_note: Sell Enchanter's Emblem for this.

items.name: Lightning Scroll
items.caption: Singularity deals damage (damage per second), so it applies the item's 0.75s stun after a 3s delay plus 150 damage. Takes spirit from 19,200 to 25,600 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Replaces Trophy Collector: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: Sell Trophy Collector for this.

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on Rejuvenating Aurora: resets its 28s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown. Takes spirit from 19,200 to 22,400 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Replaces Rapid Recharge: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: On Rejuvenating Aurora. Sell Rapid Recharge for this.

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)
items.legacy_note: Sell Heroic Aura (or Knockdown) for this.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 318s of base cooldown across your kit, 250s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Takes spirit from 19,200 to 22,400 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Replaces Greater Expansion: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: Sell Greater Expansion for this.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
items.legacy_note: Upgrade of Superior Cooldown.
